invariant_patterns.brief: Unique composite key on (sku, location) so no two rows share the same SKU-at-location pair; a repeat filing collides and updates in place (R3).
sku, location, and quantity are NOT NULL so a filed record always carries its identity and level.
CHECK quantity >= 0 so a stored stock level can never go below zero (R2).
The Alembic migration creating stock_records is additive and reversible, preserving pre-existing inventory rows across the upgrade (R1).
